basic_info.description: This charming 4 bedroom 2.5 bath home offers charm and convenience. Spanning the front of the house is the living room with a corner fireplace, cathedral ceiling and original details. It is adjacent to the formal dining room ideal for family diners and hosting holiday meals. The dining room is open to the atrium flooded with natural light and the breakfast area next to the kitchen. The kitchen boasts new stainless steel appliances and ample cabinetry. At the back of the home two spacious bedrooms with southern views overlook the large garden. One and a half baths are conveniently located off the hall. On the lower level two additional bedrooms offer direct access to the sunny deck. A full bath, a kitchenette, office and internal access to the large garage complete this level of the home. Easy access to Glen Park Bart, freeways, neighborhood shops and amenities.
